about.label: About
about.heading: From machines to marketing data
paragraphs: I work in marketing operations at a company that runs offline events connecting students with international universities. My focus is the data side: collecting it cleanly, keeping event systems reliable, and turning results into reports people can act on.

I come from a mechatronics engineering background (3+ years), so I like to treat reporting systems like machines: clear inputs, observable behavior, fewer surprises. Outside work I build my own apps and hardware projects.
